## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; confirmed by broad sector breadth ≥7/11 and cyclicals plus semiconductors leading (Financials/Consumer Discretionary strength and big semiconductors rally). Leadership concentration: Narrow (3/5 Technology in Top 5 performers).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Semiconductors/Technology lead: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: RCL (1W: +15.32% | 1M: +18.81%) ABOVE TREND, SBUX (1W: +8.13% | 1M: -2.18%) RECOVERY. Financials participating: JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -2.35%) BELOW TREND and Energy sector 1W negative. Technology shows internal dispersion with many semis ABOVE TREND but large-cap software/hypergrowth names BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, ADBE). Healthcare softening vs pockets of strength: some names ABOVE TREND (JNJ, UNH) but headline-driven weakness present.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND, RCL (1W: +15.32% | 1M: +18.81%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: ADBE (1W: -18.86% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -13.83% | 1M: -2.97%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -10.42% | 1M: +0.29%) TREND EXHAUSTION, NOW (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +15.08%) TREND EXHAUSTION, MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in large-cap software.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Fresh momentum: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND; watch major divergence as mega-cap names AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND and MSFT BELOW TREND are moving opposite the semis.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed but constructive: chip and equipment names driving gains (AMD (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +14.83%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +19.45%) ABOVE TREND) while large-cap software/FAANG cluster shows material underperformance (AAPL BELOW TREND, MSFT BELOW TREND, ADBE BELOW TREND) — watch NVDA (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -9.03%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Healthy and durable: JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND, broad Financials 1W +3.29% with many names participating; V (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +0.65%) shows trend exhaustion but overall Financials favored in this rotation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Defensive elements holding but mixed headlines: JNJ (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +1.83%) ABOVE TREND, yet negative news for some biotech/medtech names warrants monitoring.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Financials and semiconductor equipment/AI-exposed semis; reduce exposure to large-cap software names showing BELOW TREND and trend exhaustion. Monitor major-cap divergence for tactical volatility and sentiment-driven distribution (ORCL positive news but price weak).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -18.86% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Semiconductors/Technology (equipment and AI names leading; sector 1W +0.80%), Financials (1W +3.29%). BEARISH: Energy (1W -0.37%) and large-cap software within Technology.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
INTC: continuation above the recent breakout week would confirm further follow-through (momentum confirmation). AAPL: failure to stabilize at recent intraday lows reinforces BELOW TREND risk. NVDA: re-claim of monthly downrange would convert POTENTIAL REVERSAL into recovery signal. JPM: sustain ABOVE TREND momentum to signal Financials leadership continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
INTC (+60): "Intel gets a $170 billion AI reason to matter again" — price confirming: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed.  
AMD (+50): "Micron, AMD Lead Chip Stocks Rally On U.S.-Iran Deal" — price confirming: AMD (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +14.83%) ABOVE TREND.  
ORCL (+50): "DA Davidson Boosts Oracle Price Target" — price diverging: ORCL (1W: -13.83% | 1M: -2.97%) BELOW TREND, bullish news but distribution risk.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
ACN (-50): "Accenture downgraded" — price confirming: ACN (1W: -4.47% | 1M: +6.66%) TREND EXHAUSTION, negative sentiment aligns with near-term softening.  
CVX (-45): "Energy sell-off as crude sinks" — price showing exhaustion: CVX (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +1.58%) TREND EXHAUSTION, energy news weighs on the sector.  
AMGN (-75): headline risk on FDA/Tavneos dispute — watch for follow-through (monitor price action for confirmation).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with mixed style (Growth and Value participation).  
Semiconductors and Financials showing relative strength: INTC ABOVE TREND, AMAT ABOVE TREND, JPM ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk: major divergence among mega-cap tech (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL BELOW TREND) and a handful of news-driven divergences (ORCL positive news vs falling price) — monitor for trend breaks.
